Name: Bela, Son of Azaz
Summary: Son of Azaz son of Shema son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 5:8: Son of Azaz son of Shema son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Bela stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
